weather.label: Prepare
weather.summary: Tropical Storm Alma approaching NW Bahamas. Sustained winds 45–55 kt. Storm surge 2–4 ft possible on north shore. Multi-agency transport coordination advised for Nassau Metro NEMT and hospital partners (PMH, Doctor's Hospital).

institutional.headline: Flash Update: Dialysis transport at risk if CORR-01/CORR-02 close
institutional.summary: OCHA recommends coordinated holds between Nassau Metro NEMT and Princess Margaret / Doctor's Hospital transport desks. P1 dialysis patients flagged across both hospital partners.

institutional.headline: Paradise Island bridge + Eastern Road segments in regional exposure index
institutional.summary: Historical flood exposure on CORR-01 (Paradise Island approach) and CORR-02 (Eastern Road low segment). NEMT operators should sync corridor status with hospital liaisons before releasing P1 routes.
